summary: Quantize the GLM Spark projection set and BF16 MTP experts during loading
compatibility: Opt-in exact target configurations; existing online quantization defaults are unchanged. NVFP4 W4A16 requires a supported BF16-activation MoE backend. MXFP8 scale compression is not enabled.
details: Strict targets reject missing projections, incomplete fused groups and independently enabled online quantizers outside the declared set.
The GLM example selects 531 MXFP8 projections and NVFP4 W4A16 MTP routed experts; main and draft scale-compression policies are independent.
Layerwise loading releases replaced full-precision parameters before packed-weight preparation, and NVFP4 encoding writes directly into bounded output storage.
